whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Full Moon Multi Cuisine Restaurant Cafe & Hotel,

I noticed your restaurant has solid 4.1★ reviews on Bhootnath Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online table reservations and home delivery menus.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, multi-cuisine menu showcase, aur instant directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/fullmoon

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Full Moon Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Full Moon Multi Cuisine Restaurant Cafe & Hotel) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, multi-cuisine menu showcase, and easy directions from Bhootnath Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual interior photos aur online ordering setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
